messages:
Sam H: FYI — follow-up from last night's paging incident. We got the prod clusters stable and customer-facing APIs are green but we should lock down next steps for RCA and customer comms.
Maya R: +1. thanks to everyone who jumped in. quick ask: can we schedule the postmortem this week? customer asked for a timeline.
Liam C: I can host the postmortem on Thu 16:00 PT, 45m. Will that work for CS and SRE?
Jordan (CS): Thu 16:00 PT works for the customer liaison team. we need a draft RCA and action list before then so we don't surprise the customer.
Priya (SRE): Agreed. I'll run a quick sync with oncall folks tomorrow AM to capture timeline and mitigation details.
incident-bot: Incident #INC-2026-042: Memory leak in inference runtime — Severity 2 — Resolved. Pager closed by Priya (SRE).
Sam H: Notes from night ops: root cause appears to be a regression in KV cache eviction that caused OOM in several GPUs under sustained traffic. Mitigation was rolling back the cache change and restarting pools.
Maya R: Okay — for customer comms we should include: impact window, number of affected requests, mitigation steps taken, and planned fixes with ETA. Jordan do you want to draft the external note or should we?
Jordan (CS): I'll start the customer-facing draft, pinging legal only if wording mentions any SLA credits. we'll offer a 1% credit for the affected hour and a proactive dedicated sync.
Liam C: Action items I propose: 1) Add KV cache eviction metrics and alert (owner: Priya). 2) Revert fix/backport with test harness (owner: Liam). 3) Canary with synthetic load for 72h (owner: Sam).
Priya (SRE): +1. I'll add the alert with threshold and runbooks. ETA EOD tomorrow for the dashboard and alert.
Sam H: Liam — can you create the PR for the backport and include the failing trace? put it in the incident board under "critical".
Liam C: On it. I'll include heap dumps and a reduced repro. PR target: tomorrow morning.
Jordan (CS): Draft customer note (internal):

Jordan (CS): ```
We experienced a degradation from 02:14–03:26 UTC affecting ~3% of inference requests due to a memory management regression in our runtime. Our engineers reverted the change and restarted affected instances, restoring service. We will follow up with a full RCA and remediation plan by <date>. We apologize for the disruption and will reach out to schedule a dedicated technical review.
```

Maya R: That reads well. Suggest we specify customer impact as request latency spikes and ~120k affected requests, if ops can confirm counts.
Priya (SRE): Confirmed: ~118,500 requests impacted, error rate peaked at 4.2% on the inference endpoint during the window. I'll drop exact numbers into the draft.
incident-bot: Action created: Add KV cache eviction alert — assignee: Priya (SRE) — due: 2026-04-09.
Sam H: Also need a public status page entry. Jordan, can you post a concise statuspage update once the RCA is ready to share? Use the short blameless wording.
Jordan (CS): Will do. Proposed StatusPage blurb: "Partial degradation of inference API due to memory regression. Mitigated by rollback and restart. Full RCA forthcoming." Thoughts?
Liam C: Fine. Add a technical note link after the RCA is posted.
Maya R: We should schedule a customer-facing call next week. Jordan, ask which times work and I'll hold a slot Thurs/Fri mornings.
Jordan (CS): I'll poll them today.
Sam H: Remediation timeline:
- Priya: alerts + dashboard — EOD 2026-04-09
- Liam: backport PR + tests — 2026-04-10
- Sam: canary run + monitoring for 72h — complete by 2026-04-13
- Follow-up customer call — target week of 2026-04-13
Maya R: Assign owners in the incident board and link to tickets. I'll own follow-through and weekly check-ins until closure.
Priya (SRE): Quick note: add a regression test in CI for long-lived KV cache under load. I'll draft test plan and sync with eng-runtime.
Liam C: I'll add the repro to the PR and tag eng-runtime for kernel selection review.
incident-bot: Incident #INC-2026-042 updated: Postmortem scheduled Thu 2026-04-09 16:00 PT.
deploy-bot: Canary: scheduled for 2026-04-11 03:00 UTC — to run on canary pool.
Sam H: Thanks team. Final items before postmortem: Priya please attach logs + timeline to the incident doc, Liam attach PR link, Jordan attach customer comm draft. We'll review those live.
Jordan (CS): I'll upload the draft to the doc and tag Legal if needed.
Maya R: One trust-restoration idea — offer customers a technical walkthrough + 30min credit toward next month for accounts hit above threshold. Jordan, include that as an option in outreach.
Jordan (CS): Noted. I'll include options: technical review, 1% credit for the hour, and expedited support for a month.
Priya (SRE): I'll prepare the internal timeline and failure-mode matrices for the postmortem.
Sam H: Good. Closing notes: try to keep postmortem blameless, include concrete action owners and dates. We'll use the incident board to track closure.
Maya R: Thanks all. If anyone needs to add anything before EOD, drop it here.
Liam C: Added my PR link to the incident board.
Jordan (CS): Poll sent to customer — awaiting availability.
Priya (SRE): Dashboard and alert PR open: https://git.company/repo/pulls/4567
Sam H: Excellent. See you Thu. :thumbsup:
